color-no-hex.message: Use a design token instead of a hex literal — see src/assets/css/tokens.css and docs/reference/ui-design-tokens.md

color-named.message: Use a design token instead of a colour keyword. `color: white` is not caught by color-no-hex but is just as broken in dark mode — see src/assets/css/tokens.css

declaration-property-unit-allowed-list.message: Use a --text-* token instead of a raw font size — see src/assets/css/tokens.css. vw is allowed only inside clamp() for responsive display type.

declaration-property-value-disallowed-li.message: Use a --radius* token instead of a raw radius. 0, 50% and 100% are allowed.

declaration-property-unit-disallowed-lis.message: Use a --space-* token instead of a raw padding or margin — see src/assets/css/tokens.css. 0 is allowed, and so is any length relative to something other than the scale: vh/vw, em, %, or calc() over another token. A fixed offset that aligns with chrome rather than the scale belongs in a named custom property, not inline.
